verdict.rationale: mParticle documents connecting a built audience to audience outputs, meaning ad and engagement partners picked from its integrations directory, so audience activation to downstream tools is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack describes continuous sync cadence or near-real-time membership entry and exit. The Audiences and Composable Audiences pages appear only as titles. Missing for 10: documented continuous or near-real-time sync cadence, evidence of membership add/remove propagation to destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of activation latency.
